# [Ended] Double First-Month Credits and 1,000 Bonus Credits on Renewal

<Warning>
  This event ended on October 20, 2026 at 24:00 (UTC+8). The new event starts on October 21, 2026 at 00:00 (UTC+8). See the [new event page](/events/newbogo) for details.
</Warning>

<Note>
  **Limited time**: First-time Personal plan purchases receive bonus Credits equal to the included monthly amount for Pro and Pro+.
</Note>

- **First purchase: equal bonus Credits for Pro and Pro+**: Pro: 4,000 in the first month / Pro+: 12,000.
- **Renewal and upgrade bonus**: Renew or upgrade Pro, Pro+, or Ultra during the event to receive 1,000 bonus Credits.

Event period: September 1, 2026 at 10:00 to October 20, 2026 at 24:00 (UTC+8). Eligibility is determined by the time your order payment succeeds.

[**View the new event →**](/events/newbogo)

## First purchase: Equal bonus Credits for Pro and Pro+

If you make your first monthly Personal plan purchase during the event, you receive bonus Credits equal to the monthly included amount when you subscribe to Pro or Pro+. Your account registration date does not matter, and subscribing during a trial is eligible.

| Plan | Monthly included Credits | Bonus Credits | First-month total  |
| ---- | ------------------------ | ------------- | ------------------ |
| Pro  | 2,000 Credits            | 2,000 Credits | **4,000 Credits**  |
| Pro+ | 6,000 Credits            | 6,000 Credits | **12,000 Credits** |

## Renew or upgrade: Get 1,000 bonus Credits

<Note>
  Renew, upgrade, or resubscribe after expiration during the event to receive 1,000 bonus Credits. The same offer applies to Pro, Pro+, and Ultra. Personal plans only.
</Note>

| Plan  | Monthly included Credits | Bonus         |
| ----- | ------------------------ | ------------- |
| Pro   | 2,000 Credits            | 1,000 Credits |
| Pro+  | 6,000 Credits            | 1,000 Credits |
| Ultra | 20,000 Credits           | 1,000 Credits |

Teams and Enterprise plans are not eligible.

## FAQ

**Will orders placed after the event ends still receive bonus Credits?**

Orders paid after October 20, 2026 at 24:00 (UTC+8) are not covered by the rules on this page. Bonus Credits are granted under the new event rules. See the [new event page](/events/newbogo) for details.

**I registered a long time ago but have never paid. Does this count as my first purchase?**\
Yes. Eligibility depends on whether the account has ever completed a successful payment, not when it was registered.

**When will I receive the bonus Credits, and how long are they valid?**\
They are added automatically within a few minutes after payment succeeds. No additional action is required. They are valid for 30 days after they are issued.

**Will unused bonus Credits be cleared when the event ends?**\
No. Bonus Credits already issued remain valid for 30 days and are not cleared early when the event ends.

**Do I receive bonus Credits if my first purchase is Ultra?**\
No first-purchase bonus applies to Ultra. Renewing or upgrading an eligible subscription during the event grants 1,000 bonus Credits.

**Are Teams and Enterprise plans eligible for bonus Credits?**\
No. The offer applies only to monthly Personal plans.

## Event terms

These terms apply to qoder.com (the international site). For the qoder.cn offer, see the [Qoder CN event page](https://docs.qoder.cn/events/bogo).

### Credits bonus

1. **Event period**: September 1, 2026 at 10:00 to October 20, 2026 at 24:00 (UTC+8). Bonus eligibility is determined by whether the order payment succeeds during the event. Orders paid outside the event period are not eligible. Orders paid from October 21, 2026 at 00:00 (UTC+8) are subject to the new event rules.
2. **Eligibility**: The Credits bonus applies only to monthly Personal plans. The first-purchase bonus applies only to Pro
